usage.callShape: GET https://orbisapi.com/proxy/text-utilities-api-c4a528 (root returns API catalog). Actual operations are POST sub-paths e.g. POST https://orbisapi.com/proxy/text-utilities-api-c4a528/analyze with JSON body {text}
usage.outputShape: GET root: body.name, body.version, body.endpoints[] (list of available POST operations). For actual text processing, call the listed POST sub-endpoints (/analyze, /sentiment, /extract, /keywords, /summarize, /clean).
quirks: GET root does NOT process text — it returns the API self-description: {name, version, endpoints:["POST /analyze","POST /sentiment","POST /extract","POST /keywords","POST /summarize","POST /clean"]}.

To actually analyze/clean/summarize text you must POST to a sub-path of the proxy URL (e.g. .../text-utilities-api-c4a528/analyze) with a JSON body containing the text — these sub-paths were NOT pay-tested in this run.
Observed cost was $0.005 vs the $0.0010 registry surface price (5x higher).
Orbis proxy endpoint (orbisapi.com/proxy/) — single GET returned valid 200 JSON, no 404/refund pattern observed here.
No auth/API key required; payment via x402 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) or Solana.
usage.guide: Send a GET to https://orbisapi.com/proxy/text-utilities-api-c4a528 to retrieve the API catalog: the response JSON's endpoints[] array lists the available text operations (analyze, sentiment, extract, keywords, summarize, clean), each exposed as a POST sub-path. To process actual text, POST to the corresponding sub-path (e.g. .../text-utilities-api-c4a528/analyze) with a JSON body like {"text":"..."} and read the processed result from the response body. No API key is needed; each call is paid with USDC via x402 (Base or Solana). Note the GET root itself only returns the catalog, not text results.
